request.question: How exactly did adding Redis caching achieve a 40% reduction in API latency?
request.first_answer: I used caching to make it faster and it worked well.
request.retry_answer: I profiled the endpoint with py-spy and found that repeated Postgres queries dominated. I added a Redis cache with a 60 second TTL and invalidated keys on writes. Median latency dropped from about 800 ms to 480 ms, measured with Locust under the same load. The trade-off was slightly stale data for up to a minute.
request.related_claim: Reduced API latency by 40% by adding Redis caching.
